rule.title: Conventional Commits v1.0.0 Specification
rule.statement: Git commit messages must strictly adhere to the Conventional Commits specification: <type>(<scope>): <short description> in lowercase.
rule.rationale: Standardized commit messages allow automated semantic versioning, changelog generation, and immediate comprehension of change impact.
rule.implementation_guidance: Valid types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore, perf. Scope should match the affected module.

preferred.example: feat(rag): add excel multi-sheet extraction support

source.evidence_quote: Meaningful, structured commit messages enable automated traceability between requirements, source code modifications, and release artifacts.
